purpose: Teacher-authorized student-specific Portfolio report delivery from a current local sender package. The sender is transport-only and does not own Portfolio state, grading, rosters, MG calculations, or recipient source data.

source.package_rule: The live sender accepts only the current private package explicitly uploaded by the teacher. It must not read old Drive-era Portfolio roster/grade/recipient/report state.

package_contents.rows: selected/current local student identity, recipient routing, MG1-MG4 display values, teacher-reviewed notes, PDF path/hash, and ready state
package_contents.privacy: The package is private transport. It is never committed to GitHub and is never wrapped in Curriculum Transfer.

sender_staging.rule: Google Apps Script may use the teacher's private Drive only for its own transient current-package staging and persistent email send log.

preflight.mastery_goal_grade_columns: Show four compact read-only MG1-MG4 values supplied by the current local package. The sender never calculates grades.
preflight.blocked_rows: An included row with a missing/invalid student email, unverified identity, missing attachment, or attachment hash mismatch blocks live send until omitted or repaired in a new local package.
preflight.missing_guardian: A missing guardian address is a visible warning but may allow student-only delivery after teacher review.

recipients.to: student email from the current local sender package
bcc: guardian emails from the current local sender package
support-staff emails from the current local sender package when includeSupportStaff=true
recipients.privacy: Use BCC for non-student recipients. Deduplicate all addresses. Never combine multiple students in one message.

family_language.body_rule: Use short, plain-language wording. The attached report carries the detailed evidence and next-step information.
family_language.powerschool: PowerSchool shows one current grade for each Mastery Goal after enough evidence exists.
family_language.in_progress: I means In Progress and can change as the student shows more evidence.
family_language.notes: Include only the weekly/student notes carried in the reviewed local package.

identity_safety.hard_rule: Never send an attachment unless the loaded package marks identity_verified=true and the sender re-verifies the staged PDF hash against pdf_sha256.
identity_safety.duplicate_student_key: Duplicate student_key rows fail package load.
identity_safety.stale_package: The sender displays package generated/loaded metadata. The teacher is responsible for loading the current local package before send.

ui_workflow.load: Choose Portfolio_Email_Sender_Package.zip and click Load Local Package.
ui_workflow.review: Review every row, MG1-MG4, exact recipients, notes, warnings, and blocked state.
ui_workflow.recheck: Any Send checkbox or support-staff toggle change marks the view dirty and disables test/live send until Recheck succeeds.
ui_workflow.test: Send Test to Me sends only the selected student's exact message/attachment to the teacher.
ui_workflow.live_send_label: The live button dynamically says LIVE SEND — EMAIL <student_count> STUDENTS NOW when ready.
ui_workflow.live_confirmation: Before live send, show student-email count and total-recipient count and explicitly state This is not a test.
